st_remedes.name: Allée des Ballons
st_remedes.alt: A sunny cobbled lane with balloons at the windows and a green-cross shopfront, painted in ink and gouache: Monsieur Verbe the mime kneels to fasten a silver buckle on his shoe, coughs into his elbow so hard his toupee pops up, raises a tall flagpole on a grassy mound, balances a tray of lemonade glasses with a fly on his nose and a hand mirror at his belt, blows up a huge red balloon and soaks up a bucket of water with a giant sponge. The stone archway on the left leads back to the Quartier de la Santé; the blue door, the green door and the iron gate lead on.

doors.label: Rue des Accrocs
doors.hint: Through the blue door under the striped awning

doors.label: Place de la Renaissance
doors.hint: Through the iron garden gate under the roses

accrocs.name: Rue des Accrocs
accrocs.alt: A narrow back lane with a white picket fence and hollyhocks: Monsieur Verbe the mime holds out the waistband of his far-too-big trousers beside a little salad bowl, shields a flickering candle, tears his trouser leg on the fence, gives his sandwich to a hungry little dog, looks dismayed at a dented cake where a bee has landed and strains to push a cart of giant pencils up the slope. The old wooden door on the left leads back to the lane.

doors.label: Allée des Ballons
doors.hint: Back through the old wooden door

soulagement.name: Rue du Soulagement
soulagement.alt: A calm little square with plane trees and a small museum: Monsieur Verbe the mime sits for a check-up while a friendly owl doctor listens with a stethoscope, lifts a heavy sack off a smiling donkey, gestures like a museum guide at a blank framed plaque with a hand mirror at his belt, relaxes in a striped hammock, proudly holds up a cactus beside an empty watering can and trips over a big pumpkin. The green arched door on the left leads back to the lane.

doors.label: Allée des Ballons
doors.hint: Back through the green arched door

renaissance.name: Place de la Renaissance
renaissance.alt: A spring garden square with blossom trees and a fountain: Monsieur Verbe the mime faints onto a big red cushion, his hand mirror slipping, beside a toy van with three little cartoon spiders, sits glumly by a melting snowman, bandages a toy rocking horse in a green beret, cheers as a golden phoenix rises from a bowl of ashes, unties a huge rope knot and, older now with a medal, leafs through his picture album. The rose-arch garden gate on the left leads back to the lane.

doors.label: Allée des Ballons
doors.hint: Back through the rose-arch garden gate
